title: Lock-order fix needs a DODAG scope revalidation fence
description: After moving Link validation ahead of the DODAG consumer lock to fix s0ia, process_authenticated_dio reads rpl_instance_id/dodag_id without a snapshot lock and prepare_candidate does not reject if DODAG scope changes before the atomic transaction reacquires the consumer lock. Evidence sealed for the old scope could be processed against new routing state. Snapshot scope briefly before Link admission and revalidate parsed instance/DODAG under consumer_lock before policy/routing commit; add a deterministic interleave regression.
close_reason: Implemented: prepare_candidate revalidates DODAG scope from the pre-transaction snapshot and raises 'DODAG scope changed during authenticated DIO admission' (python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py:571-577), rejecting evidence sealed for an old scope before the atomic commit reacquires the consumer lock; the snapshot itself is taken atomically under the lock (dodag.py:542-557). python/tests/timing + python/tests/link: 1704 passed, 12 skipped.
